sevenCaseAdjudication.source: [pic=2]Thanks for choosing Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom!

sevenCaseAdjudication.rationale: Accept the documented single service name Flug im Nu. Penny thanks the traveler; preserve the entire thank-you and picture command. Other established service occurrences in 62/139/209 demonstrate this is one recurring named service.

sevenCaseAdjudication.source: [pic=1]Finally, by riding Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom you accept any and all accidental damages that can happen and may result in permanent damage, and or death!
sevenCaseAdjudication.oldTarget: [pic=1]Und schließlich: Mit der Nutzung von Penny Feders Flug und Flitz akzeptierst du sämtliche möglichen Unfallschäden, die zu bleibenden Schäden und/oder zum Tod führen können!
sevenCaseAdjudication.newTarget: [pic=1]Und schließlich: Mit der Nutzung von Penny Feders Flug im Nu akzeptierst du sämtliche möglichen Unfallschäden, die zu bleibenden Schäden und/oder zum Tod führen können!
sevenCaseAdjudication.rationale: Accept the same recurring service-name correction. Preserve every liability clause, possibility, permanent harm, death and picture control; no other wording changed.

sevenCaseAdjudication.rationale: Accept the same recurring service-name correction. Penny remains the sole employee every day; retain female speaker agreement and the entire statement.

sevenCaseAdjudication.source: [pic=1]Maverick sure was acting up though! Kept going on and on about his cousin getting hit by lightning.
sevenCaseAdjudication.oldTarget: [pic=1]Maverick hat allerdings ganz schön verrücktgespielt! Er hat die ganze Zeit davon geredet, dass ein Cousin oder eine Cousine von ihm vom Blitz getroffen wurde.
sevenCaseAdjudication.newTarget: [pic=1]Maverick hat allerdings ganz schön verrücktgespielt! Er hat die ganze Zeit davon geredet, dass sein Cousin vom Blitz getroffen wurde.
sevenCaseAdjudication.rationale: Reverse the earlier uncertainty decision on concrete missed primary evidence: 468:767 explicitly links to 468:768, Now he walks all funny. He refers to Maverick’s lightning-struck cousin, supporting male Cousin. Dustin reports the same relative in 481:749. Preserve kinship degree, past lightning and repeated anxious talk; do not import the twice detail from the other occurrence.

Retain boast, pause, easy-task idiom and indefinite wolf; no early name reveal.
